_comment: DevAI-Hub curated MCP server configurations for Claude Code. Copy the servers you need into your .claude/settings.json under the 'mcpServers' key. Keep active MCPs under 10 to preserve context window. Set required env vars before enabling a server.

filesystem._comment: Replace /path/to/your/project with your actual project root

context7._comment: Up-to-date library documentation and code examples

devai-skill-server._comment: DevAI-Hub skill discovery MCP server. Provides search_skills, get_skill, list_categories, list_bundles, and get_bundle tools. Set DEVAI_HUB_ROOT to the DevAI-Hub repo root, or install via the DevAI-Hub installer. Falls back to ~/.devai-hub/. Requires Python 3.10+.

_usage.install: Copy desired server blocks from 'mcpServers' above into your ~/.claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.json (project-level).
_usage.format: The 'mcpServers' key at root of settings.json accepts an object where each key is the server name and each value is its config.
_usage.env_vars: Set required environment variables in your shell profile or .env file before starting Claude Code. Never hardcode tokens.
_usage.limit: Keep the total number of enabled MCP servers under 10 to preserve context window capacity.
_usage.disable_per_project: To disable a server for a specific project, add its name to the 'disabledMcpServers' array in the project's .claude/settings.json.
